hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; if [ -x ./venv/bin/python ] && [ -d var/runs ]; then ./venv/bin/python -m runregistrykit list 2>&1 || echo 'run registry: runregistrykit list failed; run it by hand'; else echo 'run registry: not available here (no ./venv/bin/python or var/runs/); skipped'; fi; exit 0
